verdict.rationale: Anytype ships a documented local API bundled with the desktop app, a developer portal with examples (developers.anytype.io/docs/examples, including an MCP example), a headless CLI for scripting, and a gRPC API. Together these let developers build external integrations and automations against documented interfaces. However, nothing in the evidence shows an in-app plugin or extension system or a plugin SDK, so this is integration via API rather than true plugin development. missing for 10: an in-app plugin/extension API or SDK, plugin-specific samples and docs, an OpenAPI/reference spec found by the probe, independent hands-on corroboration of building on the API.
